name: cabin-raise
description: Day 3's cabin request (design/22 #5 and #6). With $320 bid by hand and no plan, it doesn't fit the bidding power, so Glim says so and suggests a raise to $1,000; the guest approves any new hold with PayPal. With the $500 plan running, even $1,000 can't cover the $660 next bid, so code refuses the raise and the retry says so plainly.
guestText: Can you also get me the cabin?

content.text: The Cabin Stay’s next bid is $660, more than your bidding power has room for. Want to raise it?
The Cabin Stay’s next bid is $660, and your plan uses all $500. Even at this gala’s $1,000 maximum, it won’t fit.
